rules: a context line is a verbatim run of the quote or is dropped
no key_number or key_label on any slide or on the static (a label short enough would drop who was studied)
never write number words (one, two, first, ...) anywhere in framing lines, the caption, the reasoning or the message; say 'both measures', not 'two measures'
1.81% always has 'lean mass as a share of total weight' right beside it, on every slide and line where it appears
the line about pairing treatment with nutrition and exercise cites claim c007-01 only (never c000-00 or c000-01), and has no number
carousel.why: Brief targeted by the learning loop (steer learn, trials/s6-1: doubt 'muscle' scored highest, 3 of 11 benchmark posts; rule from CONTEXT_NOT_IN_QUOTE). Laverde 2026 (CC BY): absolute lean mass fell 1.74 kg (results varied a lot between studies, I2 = 98%) while lean mass as a share of total weight rose 1.81%; keep the two separate, each with its own label; the paper's advice to pair treatment with nutrition and exercise. STRICT: every health line, every key label and the message name who was studied with this exact phrase: 'patients with obesity treated with GLP-1 receptor agonists at obesity doses' (never drop 'at obesity doses'); a key_label is copied word for word from its health line and includes that phrase; never write number words (one, two, ...) in framing lines, the reasoning or the message (the checker reads them as numbers). No key_number/key_label on any slide (the slide's hero card shows the number with its line). In the reasoning, never write 'two measures' or any number word: say 'both measures'.

reel.hook: the viewer's doubt, short: 'Will I lose muscle on these medicines?' is NOT allowed (the paper measured lean mass, not muscle); use lean mass, e.g. 'Losing weight, losing lean mass too?'
reel.order: one numbers line from c000-01: 'In patients with obesity treated with GLP-1 receptor agonists at obesity doses, absolute lean mass changed by -1.74 kg on average; results varied a lot between studies' (the number with its sign as in the quote; never 'fell 1.74 kg'; never say muscle)
reel.why: SHORT (at most 24 spoken words): 'In patients with obesity treated with GLP-1 receptor agonists at obesity doses, lean mass as a share of total weight rose 1.81%' (c000-00; the label right beside 1.81%); the 'setting' line of this scene is copied exactly from a health line
reel.brand_line: Before you start, hear it from a doctor, not a reel.
reel.message: every slide, caption line and the message keep the two numbers separate, each with its label right beside it ('absolute lean mass' beside -1.74 kg; 'lean mass as a share of total weight' beside 1.81%), and say, from the paper's own context sentence, that the authors call it essential to pair treatment with nutrition and physical exercise

carousel.rules_provenance: rule 1 from the learning loop (trials/s6-1); rules 2-4 editorial for this brief, from the checks' findings on earlier tries
